style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, white sunlit interior
character: glossy dark red leech, thick ribbed body, no legs, round spectacles, banker's collar, tired eyes, fills two thirds of frame
props: a clear tube on his tail sucker running down the hall into a huge wooden barrel behind a steel press, ДЕНЬГИ КРОВЬ ЭКОНОМИКИ painted on the barrel in big cyrillic capitals on three lines, red rising inside it; two clerk mites on his back, one with a stamp, one with a ledger strip; a fat bear banker in a monocle and white lace jabot cranking a handle on the side of the press with two dainty claws
prop_continuity: tube on his tail until it tears off in the rolls; dark red pales to grey as the barrel fills; flat as paper and alive from 7.85
motion_rule: every window he surges down the hall toward the lens, body undulating, front sucker free and never attached; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: flooded bank hall, water over white marble, huge sunlit windows, gold spray in the beams

audio.delivery: flat tired male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: VY-dal, kre-DEET, te-PER, DOL-zhen, po-SLED-ney, KAP-li, KRO-vi
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 7.05
audio.lip_sync: front sucker opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: water sloshing, stamp thud, rolls grinding, crank creaking, wind

timeline.a: he lunges his sucker at a wad of banknotes at the lens, the tube yanks him back mid-bite, a red jet running the wrong way out of him
timeline.c: big close on his mouth and the wad, whip to the tube

timeline.a: he surges at the lens down the flooded hall, the stamp mite hammering a stamp into his back
he throws his head sideways, the tube snaps taut and rips spray off the water at the lens
timeline.c: big close on the taut tube, whip

timeline.line: что я теперь должен ему все
timeline.a: he drives on toward the windows, the ledger mite unrolling a strip down his flank
he rams into the water, spray at the lens, both mites swinging out still hooked, the bear at the far press cranking once behind the spray
he heaves into the window light, his dark red draining to grey along his body
still surging at the lens, he lifts his grey head as the red in the barrel behind him climbs
timeline.c: big close low frontal, push in

timeline.a: the grey leech surges onto the marble and is dragged head first into the rolls, tube tearing off, mites leaping clear
timeline.c: tight low frontal on the rolls, push in

timeline.a: he shoots out the near side flat as paper, spectacles still on, alive and flapping, and rears up flat at the lens
timeline.c: big close low, whip up with him

timeline.a: the fat bear banker leans into the lens over his crank, monocle flashing, jabot bouncing, cranking daintily while the barrel behind him fills to the brim and slops over
timeline.c: push in to a big close on the bear and the crank, the flat leech flapping past the lens

must_appear: the rolls squeezing him flat; the flat leech alive and flapping; the bear in the monocle and jabot turning the crank in big close at 9.0; ДЕНЬГИ КРОВЬ ЭКОНОМИКИ readable on the barrel
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, garbled or misspelled words, any lettering other than ДЕНЬГИ КРОВЬ ЭКОНОМИКИ, static camera, a wide with him small in frame, he stands still while speaking, his sucker attached to anything, a leech with legs or fins, the bear seen from behind or small in frame, the bear straining or sweating, English speech, any word after 7.05, the leech dying or torn at the rolls, a leech still thick after the rolls
